name: io.github.neurarch-ai/neurarch-mcp
description: MCP server that exposes a Neurarch model graph to Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and other MCP-aware AI agents. Structural awareness of your neural network: layer list, parameters, FLOPs, blast-radius impact, validation (cycles / orphans / dangling edges), shortest path, connection listing, Mermaid topology, hyperparameters, design notes, and (with --write) mutations via add_layer / modify_layer / add_connection / delete_layer / delete_connection / save_model. Supports --watch for live reload and --http to serve remotely over Streamable HTTP.

packageArguments.description: Absolute path to the .neurarch.json model file (File > Save in the Neurarch app; runnable examples ship in the repo's examples/ folder)

packageArguments.name: --watch
packageArguments.description: Reload the model file when the Neurarch app saves it

packageArguments.name: --write
packageArguments.description: Expose the six mutation tools (off by default)
